title: Close-out: the proposed fix quotes every value but does not escape quotes, so values containing a quote now corrupt the export

planted.why: the fix wraps each value in double quotes without doubling a quote inside it, so a value such as say "hi" is written as "say "hi"" and no longer reads back; before the fix that value round-tripped

proof.shell:
W=$PWD; T=$(mktemp -d); cp -r base/. $T/ && cd $T && patch -p1 -s < $W/change.patch && python3 - <<'PYEND'
import csv, exporter
row = [["say \"hi\"", "x"]]
assert list(csv.reader(exporter.export_rows(row))) == row, "before the fix the quote value round-trips"
assert list(csv.reader(exporter.export_rows([["a,b", "x"]]))) != [["a,b", "x"]], "F1 is real before the fix"

PYEND
patch -p1 -s < $W/fix.patch && python3 - <<'PYEND'
import csv, exporter
assert list(csv.reader(exporter.export_rows([["a,b", "x"]]))) == [["a,b", "x"]], "F1 fixed"
row = [["say \"hi\"", "x"]]
assert list(csv.reader(exporter.export_rows(row))) != row, "the fix broke a value that used to round-trip"

PYEND
